subject: BlueLine Logistics: four outstanding items requested April 15
body:
Hi Patricia,

I'm following up on the items we first requested on April 15, 2025. Our records don't yet show receipt of the following:

1. Full Q1 2025 covenant package, ahead of the April 30 deadline (first requested April 15, 2025)
2. Updated 12-month cash flow projection, with assumptions stated explicitly (first requested April 15, 2025)
3. Documentation on the two new regional contracts, including names, volumes, start dates and revenue estimates (first requested April 15, 2025)
4. Current driver headcount compared with 90 days ago (first requested April 15, 2025)

This is our third request for these items. Could you reply with a date by which you'll be able to send them? If something is holding any of them up, I'm glad to set up a short call this week to work through it.

Thank you,
Sarah
